summaries.zh: GitHub加入联盟，呼吁修改加州AI透明度法案，以解决与开源许可的冲突，使其与国际透明度框架保持一致，同时保留法规意图。此举旨在保护开源社区，确保法案不影响开源项目的透明度和合规性。
summaries.en: GitHub has joined a coalition advocating for amendments to California's AI Transparency Act. The group seeks targeted changes to resolve conflicts with open-source licensing and align with international transparency frameworks, while preserving the act's regulatory intent. The initiative aims to protect open-source development while ensuring compliance with AI regulations. (Word count: 50)

items.title: What are git worktrees, and why should I use them?
items.content:
Git worktrees have been around since 2015, but it wasn't until recently they became popular. Learn what they are, how to use them, and why you might.

The post What are git worktrees, and why should I use them? appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Git worktrees have been around since 2015, but it wasn't until recently they became popular. Learn what they are, how to use them, and why you might.
The post What are git worktrees, and why should I use them? appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Natalie Guevara

summaries.zh: Git工作树是Git自2015年起就存在的功能，近期才变得流行。它允许用户在同一仓库中创建多个独立的工作目录，方便并行开发或管理不同分支。使用工作树可以轻松切换和比较分支，无需频繁切换git状态。本文介绍了Git工作树的概念、使用方法及其优势，适合需要高效管理代码的开发者参考。
summaries.en: Git worktrees allow users to access multiple branches or commits of a repository simultaneously by creating separate working directories. Introduced in 2015, they gained popularity recently. Worktrees enable developers to switch between branches without cloning the entire repository each time, improving workflow efficiency. They are useful for managing multiple features or experiments in one repository. The article provides an overview of what they are, how to use them, and potential benefits.

items.summary: Git工作树是Git自2015年起就存在的功能，近期才变得流行。它允许用户在同一仓库中创建多个独立的工作目录，方便并行开发或管理不同分支。使用工作树可以轻松切换和比较分支，无需频繁切换git状态。本文介绍了Git工作树的概念、使用方法及其优势，适合需要高效管理代码的开发者参考。

items.title: Accelerating researchers and developers building multilingual AI with a new open dataset
items.content:
A new repository-level dataset, published on GitHub under CC0-1.0, helps researchers and developers discover multilingual developer content across READMEs, issues, and pull requests.

The post Accelerating researchers and developers building multilingual AI with a new open dataset appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
A new repository-level dataset, published on GitHub under CC0-1.0, helps researchers and developers discover multilingual developer content across READMEs, issues, and pull requests.
The post Accelerating researchers and developers building multilingual AI with a new open dataset appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Natalie Guevara

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了GitHub发布的一个新的开放数据集，该数据集以CC0-1.0协议发布，包含README、问题和拉取请求中的多语言开发者内容。该数据集旨在帮助研究人员和开发者构建多语言AI。
summaries.en: A new open dataset, published on GitHub under CC0-1.0, aids researchers and developers in discovering multilingual content across READMEs, issues, and pull requests. The dataset supports the development of multilingual AI by providing access to diverse language data. It is freely available for use, promoting collaboration and innovation in the field. The initiative aims to accelerate research and development in multilingual AI applications.
